**Why the rules never matched:** the rules lived in `packages/esm-reports-app/src/components/reports.scss`, which is a CSS Module. Components import it as `styles` (for example `reports-data-overview.component.tsx`, line 17), so Webpack/rspack rewrites every class selector to a locally scoped, hashed name. The rules were written as plain `.cds--date-picker`, `.cds--select`, `.cds--select-input` and `.cds--date-picker__input` nested under `.filterForm .formField`. Carbon's markup uses those global class names unhashed, so the compiled selectors matched nothing. The fix would have needed `:global(...)` around each Carbon class.

**What was done:** the rules were deleted, not converted to `:global`. Commit `fbda0303` ("chore: Remove inert Carbon CSS rules from reports app (#358)") removed the four nested blocks from `.filterForm .formField`. The `.formField` rule itself (`flex: 1`, `min-width`, `max-width`) stays. The commit body has no ticket key, and Falkon's indexed data for it has none, so I can't name the ticket.

**Related but separate:** commit `feb0ba00` removed other unreferenced CSS Module classes in the same app, in the same CSS-Module-scoping reasoning. Commit `827b70e6` later removed the fixed 300px widths on the run-report and scheduled-report selects, so those fields are now full width through the Carbon `Stack` layout instead of these rules.
